About the Clinic

Skin care that starts with listening.

Skin World is led by Dr. Shantanu Mishra (MBBS, DVD), a dermatologist serving Bilaspur from the heart of Idgah Chowk. Every plan begins with understanding your skin, then using safe, modern treatments with honest expectations.

Treatments

Care for every skin and hair concern.

Hydra Facial

A gentle, non-invasive treatment that cleanses, hydrates and refreshes skin for a healthy, good-looking glow.

PRP Hair Treatment

A modern approach to controlling hair fall, planned after a proper check of your scalp and hair.

Laser Hair Removal

Precise, personalised sessions that save time and help prevent ingrown hair.

Dark Spot & Pigmentation

Targeted treatment to even out skin tone and reduce spots, chosen for your skin type.

Tattoo Removal

Laser tattoo fading with a clear plan, so you know what to expect before you begin.

Skin Consultation

Rashes, acne, allergies or everyday skin worries. Start with a proper diagnosis.

Skin Care Guide

Simple habits for every season.

Summer

Protect your skin from the sun · Stay hydrated · Wash and moisturise daily · Eat a balanced diet · Manage stress

Monsoon

Apply sunscreen every day · Cleanse your face 2–3 times a day · Wear minimal or no makeup · Use lightweight moisturisers · Avoid deep-fried snacks
